title: Best Verve AI Alternative — Amigo AI Interview Copilot
description: Looking for a Verve AI alternative? Amigo offers real-time interview help with OS-level stealth, Buddy mode, and pay-as-you-go pricing — no subscription tiers. Try free, no card.

mainEntity.name: Is Amigo a good Verve AI alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo matches Verve AI's real-time interview assistance and adds what it lacks: a Buddy mode for live human + AI collaboration, OS-level stealth (hidden in Task Manager and Activity Monitor, not just screen share), and pay-as-you-go pricing with credits that never expire instead of monthly subscription tiers.

mainEntity.name: How does Amigo pricing compare to Verve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verve AI uses monthly subscription tiers, with some capabilities reserved for higher plans. Amigo is pay-as-you-go — from $15 for 2 hours, every feature included, and credits never expire. Occasional interviewers don't pay for empty months.

mainEntity.name: Is Amigo more undetectable than Verve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo is hidden from screen sharing AND from the OS itself — no entry in the Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager (Windows), or Activity Monitor (macOS). Verve AI's stealth is focused on screen-share invisibility; it can still appear in system process lists.

mainEntity.name: Does Verve AI have anything Amigo doesn't?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verve AI ships a broader prep suite — a large question bank and post-session scored reports. If your priority is pre-interview practice content, that's worth a look. If your priority is live interview performance — response speed, stealth depth, human backup, and paying only for what you use — Amigo is the stronger choice, and its Practice Mode covers mock interviews.

mainEntity.name: Does Amigo support coding interviews like Verve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo's coding interview copilot works with HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad, and other platforms. It reads your screen and provides step-by-step hints, time complexity analysis, and working code solutions in real time.

mainEntity.name: Can I try Amigo for free before switching from Verve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo includes 10 minutes of free credits on sign-up with full feature access — no credit card required. Run a Practice Mode mock interview or use the minutes in a real session to compare directly.

The gaps

Why people look for an alternative

Verve AI is a popular, broad interview-prep copilot — but a few gaps send users looking elsewhere.

Subscription Lock-In

Verve AI is sold as monthly subscription tiers. You pay whether or not you have interviews that month — and the features you actually need mid-interview sit in the higher tiers.

Stealth Stops at Screen Share

Verve AI hides from screen sharing, but it is not hidden from Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS). Interviewers who check running processes can spot it.

No Human-in-the-Loop

Verve AI is AI-only. There is no way to bring a friend or mentor into your live session — no second layer of human judgment when a question goes off-script.

The edge

How Amigo pulls ahead

6 places Amigo outperforms Verve AI.

Buddy Feature

Live Human + AI Support

Invite a trusted friend or mentor via a shareable link. They watch your interview in real time and send AI-assisted tips through your Amigo overlay. No other tool offers this two-layer support system.

Deep Stealth Mode

100% Undetectable

Amigo is hidden from screen share, Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager, System Monitor, and Activity Monitor. Verve AI's invisibility stops at the screen-share level — Amigo's goes down to the OS process list.

Pay-As-You-Go Pricing

No Subscription, Credits Never Expire

Amigo uses credits you buy once — from $15 for 2 hours — with every feature included. No tiers, no monthly charge between job searches, no feature-gating.

Under 0.3s Response

Truly Real-Time

Amigo surfaces short, personalized, natural answers the moment your interviewer finishes speaking. No CTRL+ENTER required — just seamless, in-the-moment support.

Coding Interview Copilot

HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad

Amigo reads your screen during live coding challenges and provides hints, pseudocode, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

Natural STAR Answers

Scenario-Based, Not Robotic

Responses are tailored to your resume and the specific job description — structured in STAR format and adjusted to your preferred length (Concise, Balanced, or Detailed).
